Repetition of tests is a procedure described in the present document that determines when test cases need to be repeated. Generally, test cases are highly reproducible and do not require repetition unless otherwise specified. However, repetition may be required for test cases involving statistical criteria such as "at least 90%" for correct UE behavior in cell re-selection, measurement, and handover.
